headline: As of 2026-10-25: 27,916,759 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.2 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 27,916,759 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.2 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,205,566), California (2,957,913), Florida (2,680,524).
